plugin.name: TMDB
plugin.description: Info and posters for movies and series, and “Where to watch” in Search, from the TMDB catalogue. Needs a free TMDB key.

token.label: TMDB key or token
token.help: Create an account on themoviedb.org, then copy the “API read access token” from Settings, API section.

language.label: Language of the info
language.help: “auto”: Mire's language. Otherwise a code such as en-US or fr-FR.

tmdb.noKey: Add a TMDB key in the TMDB plugin settings to look up movies and series.
tmdb.watchNoKey: Add a free TMDB key to see matching movies and series here, with the service where you can watch them.
tmdb.unreachable: Can't reach the TMDB catalogue. Check your internet connection.
tmdb.keyRefused: TMDB key refused. Check it in the TMDB plugin settings.
